# scylladbcloud_serverless_bundle (Data Source)

**Deprecated**: this data source will be removed in v2.0.0. For a `scylladbcloud_cluster`, the `scylladbcloud_cql_auth` data source gives the connection details as separate attributes (seeds, username, password); there is no connection bundle file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch connection bundle file for serverless cluster identified by 1337.
data "scylladbcloud_serverless_bundle" "my" {
	cluster_id = 1337
}

output "scylladbcloud_serverless_bundle" {
    sensitive = true
	value     = data.scylladbcloud_serverless_bundle.example.connection_bundle
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) Cluster ID

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `connection_bundle` (String, Sensitive) Connection Bundle
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
